newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 6.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Jan 6.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Lend Lease Corp Ltd said on Monday it had entered preliminary negotiations with The Equitable Companies Inc of the United States over the potential acquisition of Equitable Real Estate Investment Management Inc (ERE), which manages US$25 billion of funds invested in property. Lend Lease said it would not require an issue of equity to fund the acquisition should it proceed.

St George Bank Ltd and Advance Bank Ltd said early on Monday that Advance Bank ordinary shareholders would receive 0.625 of a new St George Bank ordinary share, A$2.10 in cash from St George and a 20 cent per share special dividend for each Advance Bank share as payment for the planned merger of the two banks.

Papuan New Guinea gold miner Highlands Gold Ltd said on Monday it had submitted a restructuring proposal to hostile bidder Placer Dome Inc that would provide Highlands shareholders with substantially greater value than Placer's 75 cents per share bid.Through a scheme of arrangement, Highlands said each of its shares not held by Placer would be cancelled in exchange for a capital return of 65 cents per share and one new share in a new company, Highlands Pacific Ltd.

Swiss-controlled Insurance group HIH Winterthur Ltd said on Monday it had bought back CareAmerica Compensation and Liability Insurance Co, a unit of Care America, for US$59 million. HIH said it had set up the workers compensation unit, formerly known as Health Cal, in 1987 and then sold it in 1994 for US$93 million.
* The Broken Hill Pty Ltd A$17.73 (-0.09)
The Australian Bureau of Meteorology on Monday issued a category one cyclone warning for coastal areas between Broome and Port Hedland in Western Australia.
